slots.notes: Fullscreen autoplay/muted/loop/playsInline object-cover hero background video centered with min-w/min-h-full behind the whole hero; covered only by a bg-black/20 wash and a bottom from-bg fade, so it reads near full brightness behind the centered serif headline and floating pill nav.
Static .avif poster/fallback frame for the hero <video>, shown before the stream loads or when autoplay is blocked; should visually match the first frame of the looping hero footage.

mechanic: A 2.7s Framer Motion loading screen (rotating display words, a 000→100 rAF counter, and a gradient scaleX progress bar) fades out via AnimatePresence to hand off to a fullscreen autoplay-loop object-cover video hero whose centered serif name, blur-in eyebrow, and cycling role line animate in on a GSAP power3.out timeline.
techDelivery: Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript multi-component spec with Tailwind v3 CSS-variable theming, GSAP for the hero entrance timeline, Framer Motion (AnimatePresence/motion) for the loader, and Google Fonts (Inter + Instrument Serif) as CSS-variable font families.
reskinNotes: The blue accent gradient linear-gradient(90deg,#89AACC,#4E85BF) is hardcoded across the logo ring, button hover borders, and loader progress bar (plus a matching rgba(137,170,204,0.35) glow) rather than driven by a single token, so an accent reskin must touch every occurrence. accent in the native theme equals fg (#f5f5f5), so the gradient stops are the only true brand-accent colors. The oversized Instrument Serif italic name uses leading-[0.9] and tracking-tight, making the hero layout font-metric-dependent on a serif display swap. All copy is hardcoded in markup: the loader words (Design/Create/Inspire), nav monogram "JA" and labels, hero name "Michael Smith", the cycling role words and "lives in Chicago" role template, bio, and both CTA labels. The legibility contract assumes only a bg-black/20 overlay, so a light or busy brand video can wash out the white nav and headline.
